description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing color escape codes in a Git-related project. It defines functions to generate ANSI color codes, tests various color configurations and their correctness, and verifies behavior with invalid inputs. It also includes test cases for different color specifications and checks how the system handles unknown or invalid color slots.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Generates and verifies the ANSI color escape code based on given color specifications by fetching colors via 'git config --get-color' and comparing output.

methods.name: invalid_color
methods.description: Tests that invalid color inputs correctly fail when passed to 'git config --get-color'.
